items.title: Latest open artifacts (#22): Zyphra, Cohere, and Poolside are expanding the breadth of the ecosystem
items.summary: A trend we continue to see in open model releases is that the ecosystem is becoming more diverse, with an increasing number of organizations releasing a wide range of models. A year ago, open artifacts and the open model landscape more broadly were dominated by a handful of (Chinese) players. items.summaryZh: Interconnects专栏盘点了最新的开源模型生态（#22期），指出开源模型正从过去由极少数玩家主导走向全球化与多元化。文章将开源发布主体细分为纯模型前沿探索者（如Zyphra、Poolside、Cohere等主权AI）、利用开源引流的大厂（如阿里、谷歌、英伟达），以及将AI作为核心的产品垂直公司，反映了开源生态的深度演变。

items.title: HP Inc. launches Frontier strategic partnership with OpenAI
items.summary: HP Inc. scales its OpenAI Frontier partnership to deploy AI across customer experiences, software development, and enterprise operations.
items.summaryZh: 惠普（HP Inc.）宣布与OpenAI建立深度的“Frontier”战略合作伙伴关系。惠普将扩大与OpenAI的合作规模，把前沿AI技术广泛部署于终端客户体验、软件开发以及企业内部运营中，标志着大模型技术在传统硬件和企业级场景中的进一步落地。

aiReview.reasonZh: 惠普与OpenAI达成Frontier战略合作伙伴关系，在企业级产品和运营中全面部署AI。
